# simple-java-project

## Overview:

This project is based on java application which helped me to understand the complete maven project architecture.

## Technologies:
# 1) Maven
# 2) Java Application
# 3) EC2 instance

# What i learned:
# what is a POM file ?
# --> Maven lifecycle (CLEAN,DEFAULT,SITE)
# Commands:-
# mvn clean -- clean up old build output generated by previous builds, remove the target folder.
# mvn validate -- validate the project structure , pom file is present / not.
# mvn compile -- compiles the java application and checks for syntax-based errors.
# mvn package -- packages the compiled code into distributable format (.jar, .war)
# mvn install 
# mvn deploy

## Maven
#|
 #   ├── Download dependencies
  #  ├── Compile
   # ├── Run tests
  #  ├── Package JAR
   # └── Produce artifact
             |
             ↓
          demo.jar
